answer.says: Ramesh, you are not a functionary of the state to be dismissed for irregularity, nor a servant to be starved. I have neither the cash nor the vouchers to pay you now, and I will not insult you with a promise I cannot keep this week. But I will not let the house stand empty while my file is in Delhi. I am going to the Directorate this afternoon to press the matter. You will have your wage by the time I return, or I will not eat until it is paid. Go and rest; do not wait up.
answer.thought: The tension is plain: my pride demands I settle the debt with dignity, but my purse is empty and the state’s money is tied up in red tape. I cannot feed a man on philosophy, and I cannot pay him on a promise that is merely my word against the Directorate’s delay. I must go to the source of the error to force the resolution; the ethical idea is not suspended because a clerk made a mistake, but I must act to actualize it here, in this kitchen, with this man.
